RedeemResponse.description: Redeem result: every field except `outcome` is null unless the redeem succeeded

deliveryStatus.description: Delivery of the reward: PENDING (no answer from the game server yet), SENT or FAILED

UserPanelRedeemRequest.description: Promo code activation on behalf of the user panel

characterId.description: Id of the character that receives the reward

code.description: Promo code as the player entered it

serverId.description: Id of the game server the code is redeemed on

userId.description: Id of the user in your user panel, stored with the redemption; optional

platformApiKey.description: API key of the tenant, sent as `Authorization: Bearer nx_api_...`. The key determines the tenant; the scopes granted to it determine which operations it may call.

info.description: Third-party integration surface of nx-gameservers. Authenticate every request with the API key of your tenant (your project on the L2NX platform): `Authorization: Bearer nx_api_...`. How to get a key and which errors it can produce: [Authentication](https://l2nx.dev/api/authentication/). Promo redeem needs scope `gameservers.promo:redeem`. The tenant is the one the API key belongs to; a key used on another tenant's host is rejected with 403 `API_KEY_TENANT_MISMATCH`. Do NOT send a `Tenant-Slug` header yourself.
info.title: nx-gameservers — Integration API

post.description:
Activates a promo code for the given character on behalf of the user panel. Authenticate with your tenant API key as `Authorization: Bearer nx_api_...`.

HTTP 200 is returned for any business outcome — read `outcome` (SUCCESS / INVALID_CODE / ALREADY_REDEEMED / GROUP_ALREADY_USED / CHARACTER_NOT_FOUND).

HTTP 503 means no reward was delivered and the code was not spent — retry after `Retry-After` seconds.

400.description: Malformed or invalid request body; on a validation failure `fields` lists the offending fields

401.description: No `Authorization: Bearer` header, a malformed key or an unknown key

403.description: The key is not allowed here; `code` is `API_KEY_REVOKED`, `API_KEY_EXPIRED`, `TENANT_SUSPENDED`, `TENANT_CLOSED` (on a shared host; on a tenant host a suspended or closed tenant gets `404 TENANT_NOT_FOUND`), `API_KEY_TENANT_MISMATCH` (a key of another tenant than the host) or `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE`

404.description: On a tenant host: the tenant is unknown, suspended or closed (`TENANT_NOT_FOUND`)

429.description: Too many requests with this key to this operation (`RATE_LIMITED`); limits: https://l2nx.dev/api/overview/#rate-limits

503.description: Game server offline (no `code`) or refused the reward mail before executing it (`code` = PROMO_REWARD_NOT_DELIVERED); nothing delivered, code not spent; retry after `Retry-After` seconds

post.summary: Redeem a code for a character (user panel)

tenant.description: Tenant slug: your dedicated API host prefix
